description: This file implements OAuth2 authorization code flow endpoints for Flowise credentials, supporting authorization URL generation, token exchange, token refresh, and credential updates, with integration to a database and external OAuth2 providers.

methods.name: POST /authorize/:credentialId
methods.description: Generates OAuth2 authorization URL for a given credential ID, using stored OAuth2 configuration.

methods.name: GET /callback
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 callback, exchanges authorization code for tokens, updates credential data, and returns success or error HTML.

methods.name: POST /refresh/:credentialId
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth2 access token using stored refresh token, updates credential data, and returns success or error response.
